the design, construction, testing and operation of a large area CZT detector for a wide-field coded aperture hard X-ray telescope.
the design, assembly and performance of the CZT detectors for MIRAX-HXi and ProtoEXIST2.
developing a high performance, low cost, and low power imaging CZT detector for space application.
